visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands carefully pulls apart a soft, golden-brown bread roll, revealing a dark red bean paste and a translucent, stretchy mochi filling. In the background, several twisted pastries rest on a metal cooling rack over a white marble countertop under bright, even indoor lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a top-down view where a glass bowl is placed on a white digital scale; a stream of clear water is poured into the bowl. The background is a clean, modern kitchen workspace. (3) A bag of white glutinous rice flour is held by a hand and poured into the water bowl. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the texture of the powder. (4) Brown sugar is poured from a plastic bag into the bowl, adding a dark contrast to the white flour. The hands are the only human presence visible. (5) A black spatula is used to stir the mixture until it forms a uniform, light-beige liquid. The movement is steady and focused on the contents of the bowl. (6) A close-up shot shows the digital interface of a Healsio microwave oven, with various buttons and a blue lit display indicating the power and time settings. (7) The glass bowl containing the liquid mixture is placed inside the dark microwave cavity. The camera captures the internal light of the appliance. (8) After the first round of heating, the mixture is stirred again, showing it has become thicker and semi-solid. The spatula pulls the sticky mass to demonstrate its changing consistency. (9) Following further heating, the dough has turned into a deep amber-brown, highly elastic mochi. The hands stir it vigorously, showcasing its glossy and translucent texture. (10) Wearing clear plastic gloves, the person applies oil to their hands before handling the extremely sticky mochi. The bowl is now covered with a layer of plastic wrap. (11) The amber-colored mochi is pulled and stretched between the fingers, emphasizing its softness and elasticity. (12) The video concludes by returning to the initial shot of the bread being torn open, highlighting the enticing mochi and red bean filling once more.

The narrator's speech rate is conversational and informative, synchronized with the rhythmic BGM. (3) A digital 'beep' sound signals the microwave operation. The narrator continues the instructions, and a soft scraping sound is audible as the mochi mixture is stirred. (4) The narrator’s voice pitch rises slightly with positive valence as he demonstrates the final stretchy result. A soft pop sound effect marks the appearance of a thumb-up emoji as the BGM fades out gently.
